title: GREALISH DROPPED BY EVERTON, THEN SAYS SORRY ON INSTAGRAM
description:
Seven games, no goals, no assists, one very public apology.

Everton dropped Jack Grealish for a breach of club discipline. The club hasn't said more, so we won't guess either. He missed four matches, then came back in a friendly against Derby behind closed doors. Nobody saw the comeback because the doors were shut.

He's on a second straight loan from Manchester City, and the goals and assists column reads zero across seven appearances. He then apologised on Instagram, saying he couldn't help the team in recent weeks. At least it was honest. And unlike the comeback, the apology was open to everyone.

Fair call from Everton, or harsh? And does an Instagram apology do the job? Have your say.
